race.description: Southern Grampians Livestock And Real Estate Mdn Plate
race.comment: GASOLINE RAINBOW (8) showed little early speed last start and failed to come on in the straight when eighth, beaten 6 lengths, over 1620m at Donald. Finds a nice race and can get back to his best here. KHAN CAPITAL (4) stepped out for his debut over 1461m at Kyneton back on March 28 and finished eighth, beaten 5.5 lengths, but has trialled well since, draws beautifully and gains John Allen. LADY COLONIST (9) could only manage to finish fifth, beaten 3 lengths, at her latest appearance over 1620m at Donald. Looks to be in the right race to figure in the finish. BLACK HEX (1) might find things tough from the draw but has found only one better at two of his past three, so definitely going well enough. LA REEL DEAL (5) settled well back from a wide draw last time then wound up strongly to finish fifth over 1600m at Murtoa. Ready to peak now.
